resources.string: Your photos, videos, audio and files stay encrypted inside this app. Nothing leaves the phone and the app has no internet access.

Note: a 4-digit PIN has only 10,000 combinations. Someone holding your unlocked phone with an automation tool could try them all in about an hour. A longer PIN is much safer. Hirz never adds delays or lockouts, exactly as you asked.
The two PINs do not match. Try again.
The PIN must be at least 4 digits.
Unlock with your fingerprint. Your fingerprint never leaves the phone and cannot be read by Hirz.
This key is the only way back into your vault if you forget the PIN or reinstall the app. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe. It is shown only once and Hirz does not store it.
Type the two groups below exactly as shown.
The key does not match. Check what you wrote down.
Set battery usage for Hirz to “Unrestricted” so imports and backups are not killed in the background.
Enter your recovery key. The dashes are optional.
This recovery key is not correct.
Fingerprint is not available on this device.
Your fingerprints changed. Please unlock with your PIN and re-enable the fingerprint.
The vault is unlocked. Phase 1 only covers setup, lock and unlock. Files come in the next phases.
